content.study:
Malicious prosecution requires wrongful institution or continuation of proceedings, favourable termination, absence of reasonable and probable cause, malice and actionable damage. Abuse of process instead concerns misuse of lawful process for an improper collateral purpose.\
\
The tort balances access to justice against protection from baseless proceedings. Indian courts do not infer malice merely because a prior proceeding ended favourably. The cause of action ordinarily matures after favourable termination. Abuse of process focuses on collateral misuse rather than simply the merits of the original case.
